issues.main_description_html:
Description

Integrate the Manual Blur API into the dashboard's Anonymize 360 Images flow.

This covers wiring the frontend Manual Blur functionality to its backend API endpoints — submitting manually selected blur areas, persisting them (e.g. to the 8_blooring table), and reflecting blur status in the UI.

Scope

  • Integrate the Manual Blur API endpoint(s) for saving/applying manual blur data.
  • Send manually selected blur areas (from the 360 Image Connector / Blur Selected flow) to the API.
  • Handle API responses/callbacks correctly (success, error, processing states).
  • Reflect blur status in the UI after a successful API call (no manual refresh required).

Acceptance Criteria

  1. Manual blur selections are submitted to and persisted via the API.
  2. API success/error responses are handled gracefully in the UI (no stuck/indefinite states).
  3. Blur status is accurately reflected in the UI after integration.

Reference: docs/superpowers/specs/analyze-all.md — see §4 (Tour editor: face/plate blurring). Related to #4072, #4073, #4074 (blur work).

Refactor PhotographerLocation.jsx

Objective

Refactor the PhotographerLocation.jsx component to improve maintainability, testability, and readability by separating business logic (state management and API calls) from the UI layer. The file currently has ~1000 lines of mixed concerns.

Current State

All location states, API hooks, geocoding logic, and form submission functions are tightly coupled within the PhotographerLocation component.

Proposed Architecture

  1. hooks/useLocationForm.js

    • Responsibility: Manages all local form states.
    • State Variables: location, subLocations, inputLatLng, hasMainLocation, expandedKeys, selectedMainLocation, selectedSubLocations, etc.
    • Functions: Handlers for adding/removing sublocations, parsing/validating coordinates, and applying location data.

  2. hooks/useLocationAPI.js

    • Responsibility: Handles all data fetching and mutations.
    • Dependencies: React Query / Custom Fetch Hooks (useLazyFetch, usePatch, usePost, useDelete).
    • Functions: getLocation, saveLocation, saveSubLocation, updateSubLocation, deleteSubLocation, and getLocationByLatLng.

  3. utils/locationUtils.js

    • Responsibility: Pure helper functions to keep the component and hooks clean.
    • Functions: normalizeMain, diffSubLocation, and empty sublocation constants.

  4. PhotographerLocation.jsx

    • Responsibility: Pure UI composition.
    • Calls the custom hooks and passes state/callbacks down to presentational components (MainLocationContent, SubLocationContent, LocationMapCard, etc.).

Acceptance Criteria

  • PhotographerLocation.jsx line count is significantly reduced.
  • All unit and integration flows for setting/saving locations still work.
  • Form state management is fully isolated in useLocationForm.js.
  • API logic is fully isolated in useLocationAPI.js.

Scope

This task only covers the refactoring of PhotographerLocation.jsx and its immediate location-related logic. It does not change the user interface or existing behaviors.

issues.display_title: Issue #4105: Refactor PhotographerPortfolio.jsx to Reduce File Size and Duplicate Logic
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

The PhotographerPortfolio.jsx file has grown too large (1000+ lines). It currently contains duplicated UI components and state management logic for four portfolio types: Gothru, Google Street View, Panorra, and Matterport.

Proposed Solution

We need to decouple the UI from the business logic and eliminate redundancies:

  1. Extract UI Component: Create a reusable PortfolioAccordionItem.jsx component to handle the duplicated accordion structure.
  2. Extract Business Logic: Create a custom hook usePortfolioManager.js to manage all state (fetching, saving, deleting, and reordering) for the portfolios.
  3. Refactor Main File: Update PhotographerPortfolio.jsx to map through an array of configurations and render the extracted component using the custom hook, significantly reducing the file size.
